# abmmoi_vista.py
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk
from conexion import obtener_ruta_icono


[documentos]class abmmodmoivista(tk.Toplevel):
    def __init__(self, parent):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.title("Orden de Trabajo")
        self.geometry("600x400")
        self.iconbitmap(obtener_ruta_icono("icono.ico"))
        self.configure(bg="#f0f4f8")
        self.transient(parent)
        self.grab_set()

        self.campos = {}
        self._crear_toolstrip()
        self._crear_formulario()

    def _crear_toolstrip(self):
        self.toolstrip = tk.Frame(self, bg="#dde6ed", height=50)
        self.toolstrip.pack(fill=tk.X)
        self.toolstrip.pack_propagate(False)

        self.lblorden = tk.Label(self.toolstrip, text="Agregar",
                                 bg="#dde6ed", fg="#333", font=("Segoe UI", 10, "bold"))
        self.lblorden.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=10)

        self.btn_accion = tk.Button(self.toolstrip, text="Agregar", font=("Segoe UI", 10, "bold"),
                                    bg="#c6efce", fg="#006100")
        self.btn_accion.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=10, pady=5)

        self.btn_cancelar = tk.Button(self.toolstrip, text="❌ Cancelar", font=("Segoe UI", 10, "bold"),
                                      bg="#ffc7ce", fg="#9c0006", command=self.destroy)
        self.btn_cancelar.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=10, pady=5)

    def _crear_formulario(self):
        form = tk.Frame(self, bg="#f0f4f8")
        form.pack(padx=20, pady=10, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        campos = [
            ("calificacion_mano_obra", "Calificación Mano de Obra", "text"),
            ("operario", "Operario", "text"),
            ("Horario", "Horario", "text")
        ]

        for i, (campo, etiqueta, tipo) in enumerate(campos):
            lbl = tk.Label(form, text=f"{etiqueta}:", bg="#f0f4f8", font=("Segoe UI", 10))
            lbl.grid(row=i, column=0, sticky="e", padx=10, pady=4)

            entrada = tk.Text(form, width=25, height=1, font=("Segoe UI", 10)) if tipo == "text" else tk.Entry(form)
            entrada.grid(row=i, column=1, sticky="w", pady=4)
            self.campos[campo] = entrada
